dinner.name: Pakistani Chicken Biryani (Layered Spiced Rice with Chicken)
dinner.description: Fragrant layered rice with chicken, saffron and aromatic spices - complex Pakistani dinner classic
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices
Cook dum pukht style for 45-50 minutes
dinner.notes: The dum pukht (closed pot) method is essential
dinner.fun_fact: Pakistani biryani uses dried plums unique to Pakistan
